'''Blendri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Order's early [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Joining several other Jedi, Blendri became a Jedi Renunciate and a [[Legions of Lettow|Legionnaire]] of [[Lettow]], one of the many followers of [[Xendor]] during the [[First Great Schism]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Blendri lived on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the home of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its early years. Friends with fellow [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Danzigorro Potts]], Blendri trained with him when she ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] while he remained an apprentice. Taking on a Padawan of her own named [[Cuthallox]], Blendri and her student became enamored by the enigmatic teachings of [[Xendor]],<ref name="JvS" /> who preached that the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] was too restrictive in their teachings and wished to limit understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. When Xendor parted with the Order to found an [[Legionnaire Academy|academy]] on [[Lettow]],<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Blendri and Cuthallox departed with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jook-jook H'broozin]] to learn from Xendor.<ref name="JvS" /> Calling themselves the [[Legions of Lettow]], the Jedi Renunciates grew strong in the Force as they studied the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Bogan]] through many different Force-traditions.<ref name="TEGTW" />

When the High Council declared war on the Legions of Lettow, Blendri and Cuthallox took up [[Force-imbued sword/Legends|swords]] to protect their rights to study the Force. Meeting the Order in a full-blown conflict that would come to be known as the [[First Great Schism]], the Master-[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] pair jumped from world to world to fight off the Jedi. During a [[Duel on Corulag|duel]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], Jedi Padawan Danzigorro Potts killed Master H'broozin and attempted to kill Blendri and Cuthallox but the pair managed to escape. Padawan Potts would continue to hunt the pair throughout the war until he finally met them on the field of [[Battle of Columus|battle]] at [[Columus/Legends|Columus]]. Engaging her old friend, Blendri was outmatched and killed on the field of battle.<ref name="JvS" />
